The vendor directly operating and providing the **Transifex** software platform at **transifex.com** is **Transifex Opco LLC** (doing business as **Transifex**, part of XTM Group).

### Provider Statement
From the official **Transifex Terms of Service** (under *General Term*):
> *"These Terms are a legal agreement between you and Transifex Opco LLC which will apply to you in respect of any and all Services offered from the Website."*

Additionally, the **Transifex Privacy Policy** states:
> *"We — meaning Transifex, doing business as Transifex (also 'we,' 'us,' 'our,' and 'Transifex') — take very seriously the respect and protection of your privacy and security..."*

record.description: Transifex is a Localization Automation Platform designed for developers and marketers to efficiently publish and manage digital content across various languages. The cloud-based system supports agile development environments, streamlining continuous localization workflows for faster content delivery and updates. With operations on two continents, Transifex supports a diverse client base in nearly 50 countries and manages localization for over 40,000 projects in more than 150 languages, enhancing user experiences for companies like Atlassian, HubSpot, and Vodafone.
